name: cloud-itonami-app-edge
description: cloud-itonami-app read surface on Cloudflare Workers (ClojureScript). ADR-2608081500.

scripts.assets: mkdir -p public && cp ../../resources/itonami-fleet-catalog.edn public/ && cp ../../resources/cloud/itonami/app/oracle/fleet-core.kir.edn public/ && cp ../../../../kotoba-lang/jp-go-digital-design-system/resources/jp_go_dds/dds.css public/
scripts.build: npm run assets && node ../../../../../scripts/resource-guard.mjs run build -- amu compile --target wasm32-browser entry
scripts.dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.test: kbb --backend sci --classpath "src:../../src:$(kbb -A:cljs -Spath | tr ':' '\n' | grep kotoba-kir | tr '\n' ':')" test/fleet_core_parity.cljs
